create_rerender_pipeline: create a RerenderAVideoPipeline instance for video-to-video translation using Stable Diffusion with ControlNet and flow-based warping
run_video_rerendering: run video rerendering by calling the pipeline with input frames, control frames, and a text prompt to generate a stylized output video
build_flow_warp: build a flow warping function that warps a feature tensor using optical flow via bilinear sampling on a coordinate grid
test_consistency_check: test forward-backward optical flow consistency checking to detect occluded regions in bidirectional flow pairs
review_input_padder: review the InputPadder class that pads images so their dimensions are divisible by a specified factor for flow estimation
